population.description: Registered New Jersey voters surveyed immediately before the November 3, 2009 gubernatorial election
population.eligibility: Age 18 or older; source target population is registered New Jersey voters

fielding_contexts.source_window: November 3, 2009 after 00:00 EST and before 9:00 AM

english_comfort: I am a native English speaker
I am not a native English speaker but I am very comfortable in English
I am moderately comfortable in English
I am not very comfortable in English

common_pretreatment_items.text: Are you currently registered to vote in New Jersey?
Have you already voted in the New Jersey gubernatorial election between Jon Corzine and Chris Christie?
Which of the following best describes your level of comfort with English?
To what extent do you think of yourself as the kind of person who votes in elections?
How important is it to you to be the kind of person who votes in elections?
How much do you care about the outcome of the New Jersey gubernatorial election between Jon Corzine and Chris Christie?
How excited are you about the New Jersey gubernatorial election between Jon Corzine and Chris Christie?

arms.display_text: In answering the questions that follow, please take your time and read each question carefully. Thank you, we appreciate it!

items.text: How important is it to you to vote in {{ELECTION_DAY_REFERENCE}} election?

How convenient do you think it is to vote in {{ELECTION_DAY_REFERENCE}} election?

How clear are your thoughts and feelings about voting in {{ELECTION_DAY_REFERENCE}} election?

To what extent are your thoughts about voting in {{ELECTION_DAY_REFERENCE}} election different from your feelings about voting?

terminal_outcome.human_endpoint: binary post-election turnout determined by matching the participant to New Jersey voter turnout records
terminal_outcome.synthetic_endpoint: predicted probability that the stable synthetic persona would be recorded as having voted after receiving this complete sequence

reconstruction_policy.claim_boundary: The adapter is source-faithful in wording, order, response labels, and date routing, but does not claim pixel-identical browser reconstruction.
